audit.whatIsWrong: Goes Where He Pleases is never mentioned anywhere on the page, and it is the single most important interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot: Dr. Mundo resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him, losing health and dropping a cannister he can walk over to heal and cut the cooldown. Urgot's entire pattern is Disdain's flip into Purge and then the R impale — every one of those is an immobilise, and the first one is eaten. You have to bait it out before the flip means anything.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0] as the bait-first sequencing, and into phases[6] as the reason the late duel goes his way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, First item and 2+ items all read Skill; the mirror sets levels 1-6 and First item to Urgot with 2+ items to Dr. Mundo, matching the packet chart. diff also says HARD while diffRating says 4/10 and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup'.
audit.why: 50.22% over 1354 games is an even lane whose shape is front-loaded: Urgot wins everything through first item, and a three-item Mundo out-durabilities him. Three neutral rows hide both halves of that.
audit.corrected: Urgot through First item, Dr. Mundo at 2+ items, proposed with the win[N] pairs and ratings; diff set to EVEN at 5/10 so the three difficulty strings finally agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heart Zapper is the tracked cooldown on every screen with no number, and whys[5]/spikes[2] tell Urgot to build Bami's — a tank item the page's own itemization does not list.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1, Infected Bonesaw 4s at 975 range, Maximum Dosage 120s. Urgot's core is Black Cleaver into Sterak's.
audit.corrected: 17s, 4s, 975 and 120s written into the spikes, phases and cooldown breakdown; Bami's replaced with Black Cleaver plus Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr and dos say 'anti-heal' but no string ties Grievous Wounds to a specific heal, and breakdown.cooldowns claims Infected Bonesaw 'refunds HP'.
audit.why: Riot's Bonesaw text is current-health damage and a slow, with no refund. The heals that matter are Heart Zapper's recast, which heals a percentage of the damage it stored, and Maximum Dosage, which heals a percentage of his missing health — so the lower you push him, the more it gives back.
audit.corrected: Both real heal conditions stated, the fabricated refund removed, and Grievous Wounds attached to them in spikes[1], spikes[2] and whys[5].

notes: Biggest gap: Goes Where He Pleases was absent from the entire page. It resists the first immobilizing effect, which is exactly Disdain's flip — so the flip has to be baited before it is spent, and that is now the level 3-5 spike. Unlike the mirror, which left the percent-max-health Purge claim in place as unverified, I removed it from the three strings I rewrote (whys[6], spikes[3], late): Riot's Purge text gives no percent-health clause and the kit file carries no percentHealth flag on any Urgot ability, so shipping it as advice is a fabricated mechanic. I did not add a replacement number. Also fixed: breakdown.cooldowns claimed Infected Bonesaw refunds him health; Riot's text says current-health damage and a slow only.
